title: Research_SummarizeThePaper — from a paper to a faithful summary
subtitle: One paper, or a small set, read in full and summarized only as far as the text supports.

steps.title: Get the paper
steps.text: A DOI, URL, PDF or supplied text.

steps.title: Read the primary paper
steps.text: Methods, results, figures or tables, discussion. Abstract only: say so prominently and limit the conclusions.

steps.title: Extract the evidence
steps.text: Question, study type, population, controls, methods; each finding traced to a result, figure or table, with units and denominators.

steps.title: Weigh the limitations
steps.text: The authors' stated limitations plus any that affect the claims; your own assessment marked as an inference.

steps.title: Separate the layers
steps.text: What the data show, what the authors propose, and what remains unknown, including conflicting results.

steps.title: Write for the request
steps.text: Question, approach, findings, significance, limitations, with depth matched to the user's purpose and claims attributed to the paper.

groups.title: Never
items: Infer details from the title or abstract alone
Turn association into causation, or relative enrichment into absolute abundance
Invent bibliographic details, quotations, statistics or links

groups.title: When access is incomplete
items: Describe the gap instead of filling it from memory
Inspect supplementary data before relying on it, and cite it separately
